title: Nightscale's Lair

location.name: The Lower Black Lake
location.description: The deepest cavern of Khundrukar, where the underground lake pools into a vast flooded chamber. Acid-etched stone, half-submerged dwarven ruins, and a glittering hoard beneath the black water mark the lair of the young black dragon Nightscale, who slithered up from the Underdark and claimed the drowned heart of the stronghold.
location.environment: dungeon, flooded cavern, dragon lair, deep dark water

read_aloud: The final stair drowns into black water. Beyond, a immense flooded cavern stretches into the dark, its walls pitted and smoking where acid has eaten the stone. Half-sunk dwarven statues loom from the shallows. And there, coiled atop a reef of drowned treasure with the water sheeting off its oily black scales, waits the thing that has haunted this whole descent — Nightscale, the young black dragon. Its eyes open. The water begins to churn.

enemies.position: atop the hoard-reef, Amphibious — uses the deep water to dive and reposition
enemies.special: Nightscale. Acid Breath (30-ft line, DC 14, 11d8) recharges 5-6. Dives underwater (blindsight 30 ft) to break line of sight and set up breath. Fights to the death for its hoard.

enemies.position: roosting in the cavern ceiling, drawn to blood mid-fight
enemies.special: Optional adds — release on round 2 if the fight is going easily for a 6-PC party; otherwise omit.

encounters.tactics: Nightscale opens with Acid Breath on the clustered party, then dives. It surfaces to bite the biggest threat, then submerges again to recharge — using the deep water and darkness constantly. Fliers/ranged attackers deny it the water's safety. The half-sunk statues give cover from breath. This is a DEADLY finale for a 6-PC L5 party; the drowned terrain is the party's friend if used well.
encounters.description: The boss of the Forge of Fury. Nightscale's hoard is the reward for the entire dungeon.

loot.location: Nightscale's drowned hoard-reef (Investigation/diving to recover fully)
a frozen adventurer's remains in the hoard (if not already found)
a sealed dwarven case in the hoard — 2nd/3rd level scrolls, Investigation DC 12
Durgeddin's own masterwork plate, lost to the lake — the dungeon's capstone prize

skill_checks.success: Swim/dive effectively in the flooded cavern to recover sunken hoard or reposition against the diving dragon.
skill_checks.failure: Struggle in the deep water — half movement, disadvantage vs the dragon's underwater attacks.
skill_checks.context: Fighting and looting in the flooded lair.

skill_checks.success: Recall black dragon lore — acid immunity, amphibious ambush tactics — and coach the party's approach (advantage on the first save vs Acid Breath if acted on).

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): Nightscale (young black dragon, CR7) kept as-written — a deadly fight for 6 L5 PCs given their high-power items — with 6 optional stirge adds released only if the party is steamrolling. Do NOT inflate the dragon's numbers; use terrain (deep water, breath line, statue cover) and its dive-and-breath tactics to make it threatening. This is the finale — after victory, the pack is complete; the party surfaces with Durgeddin's legacy. 3+ interactables: half-sunk statues (breath cover), deep water (dragon's advantage / drowning risk / hidden hoard), acid-pitted ledges (crumble under weight — DEX save).
